controller: qnet_network.physics.blocks.adaptive_blocks(qber, sifted_rate_hz, dt_s, max_block_s=run, rng=seed + blocking_seed_offset, pooling=True): 10% of the bits published, 0.1 s segments, abort at 11%, no tuning constant

alpha_beta.source: selected on the tuning seeds by the closed-loop campaigns v1 (their summaries)

adaptive_blocks.path: ORION-Q loop (replay, supervisor) and the author's block functions

blocking_stress.path: the author's run_closed_loop and MLP rebuilt from the exported arrays (evaluate_realism.study_blocking_stress, transcribed)

primary.persistence: pooled controller key rate above the best timer (duration chosen with hindsight on the evaluation seeds), per point, one-sided
primary.learned: pooled controller key rate at least 0.99 times the best timer, per point and model, one-sided (difference controller - 0.99 x timer)

test: exact paired sign-flip test over the 20 seeds
multiplicity: Holm over the 2 persistence tests; Holm over the 4 learned tests
interpretation: key accounting on the simulated supervised loop; finite-key bound of the author, no signalling between the ends and no security proof for non-contiguous blocks
